compiled_state.title: [brainstorm] Phase 3 Step 3a does not emit Planning Intelligence Log before tagging brainstorm:complete
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What

The `/dso:brainstorm` skill workflow does not explicitly instruct the orchestrator to write a Planning Intelligence Log (PIL) event before tagging the epic with `brainstorm:complete`. As a result, the `ticket tag <epic-id> brainstorm:complete` command can fail with:

> Error: cannot add 'brainstorm:complete' tag: Planning Intelligence Log not found in ticket events.
> Run /dso:brainstorm on this epic first to generate the Planning Intelligence Log.

…even when /dso:brainstorm has already completed end-to-end and approval was granted.

## Where

`plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md` Phase 3 Step 3a ("Write brainstorm:complete Tag"). The current snippet runs `preconditions-record.sh` and then `ticket tag brainstorm:complete`, but does NOT run `emit-protocol-review-result.sh` against the ticket here. The scrutiny-pipeline Step 4 mentions emit-protocol-review-result.sh as "Best-effort: if the emit script fails, log a warning and continue — do not block pipeline completion" — so if that earlier emit silently fails, Step 3a's tag invocation rejects the tag.

## Evidence

Observed in an interactive /dso:brainstorm session on 2026-05-12 (epic sweet-garb-oryx / 3c01-3b89-21f3-485a):

1. The full brainstorm flow ran cleanly through Phase 2 (approval gate passed).
2. Phase 3 Step 1 created the epic via `ticket create epic ...` — success.
3. Phase 3 Step 2 linked dependencies — success.
4. Phase 3 Step 3a ran:
   ```
   .claude/scripts/dso ticket tag $EPIC brainstorm:complete
   ```
   Result:
   ```
   Error: cannot add 'brainstorm:complete' tag: Planning Intelligence Log not found in ticket events.
   ```
5. Workaround: I had to call `emit-protocol-review-result.sh --review-type=brainstorm-fidelity --pass-fail=passed --revision-cycles=1` before retrying the tag. After that the tag succeeded.

The earlier scrutiny pipeline Step 4 emit call I made (without a ticket-id, before the epic existed) returned no output — it cannot have written a per-ticket PIL event because the ticket didn't yet exist.

## Impact

Workflow blocker: the brainstorm:complete tag is the durable signal that downstream skills use to know an epic has passed scrutiny (preplanning checks it implicitly via the preconditions-validator). If the tag write fails silently or with a confusing error, the orchestrator may either (a) leave the epic untagged (which then blocks /dso:preplanning's preconditions gate), or (b) waste time debugging an apparently-correct sequence. I hit case (b) firsthand.

## Suggested Fix

In `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md` Phase 3 Step 3a, before the `ticket tag` call, explicitly instruct the orchestrator to:

1. Run `emit-protocol-review-result.sh --review-type=brainstorm-fidelity --pass-fail=passed --revision-cycles=<n>` against the just-created epic ID (or include the ticket-id parameter if the script supports it; if not, file a separate bug to add `--ticket-id` support to that script).
2. Verify the PIL event was written (e.g., grep ticket events for the protocol-review-result entry).
3. Only then attempt the `brainstorm:complete` tag.

Alternatively (cleaner fix): the `ticket tag brainstorm:complete` validation should auto-synthesize a minimal PIL event if the only thing missing is the formal log entry, or its error message should suggest the exact command to run to generate it ("Run: emit-protocol-review-result.sh --ticket-id=<epic> --review-type=brainstorm-fidelity --pass-fail=passed").

Related: bug zonky-disco-lull (5d6f-e4e0-2a7a-4be6) — brainstorm UX issue where Phase 3 displays UUID instead of alias. Both bugs touch the brainstorm Phase 3 ticket-creation handoff.

comments.body: Classification: llm-behavioral (Instruction Locality #16 — emit-protocol-review-result.sh not called after epic creation in Phase 3 Step 3a). Fix: added emit call as durability backstop after PIL comment write. Files: plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
